verdict.rationale: The evidence for image generation and editing is thin and indirect. Vendor material says a Bot "visits the art pipeline and makes the custom assets according to your creative direction." One hands-on user reports a "prototyper" Bot that generated a pattern from their logo and delivered it as a .ai file. Neither shows a native, documented prompt-to-image generation or editing feature: the work appears to run through the agent operating art tools, and depth is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing prompt-based image generation, documented image-editing workflows, supported image formats and outputs, and broader independent corroboration.
